story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; he tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 12 hours; burned hand, broke a cup, paid Rs 450 (Rs 1,200). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme. Day 3: Bilal's scheme - they each put Rs 1,000 into 10 'cheap' phones at the bazaar; at home all were plastic dummies. Angry at first, then they laughed together on the rooftop. Rs 200 left. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: teen naukriyan!' Day 4 (Teen Naukriyan): 5 AM newspaper round on an old cycle - chain broke, finished 40 houses on foot chased by a dog (+Rs 150); late to the dhaba, Rs 100 cut (+Rs 350); night tuition for Ali (Class 5) - fell asleep, Ali's ammi caught him, but Ali said 'sir taught best today', she paid Rs 300 and said 'kal bhi aana'. Rs 1,000. Cliffhanger: an unknown number calls about a delivery job - battery 1%, phone dies. Day 5 (Phone Mar Gaya): phone dead; charger plugged in - loadshedding; Bilal had sold his charger (scheme #2); paid Rs 50 at a generator mobile shop, but balance zero; a kind stranger (Chacha, white topi + beard) lent his phone. Job confirmed: delivery rider, Rs 25,000/month - in KARACHI, day after tomorrow 9 AM. Bus ticket Rs 1,500 vs Rs 950 in pocket (Rs 550 short). Cliffhanger: Ammi overheard - 'Karachi? Tum Karachi ja rahe ho?' Day 6 (Station Ki Raat): Ammi said 'Koi Karachi nahi jayega!'; Hamid: Rs 25,000/month, Abbu ki dawai. Sold his old broken cycle to a kabadi for only Rs 300 (still Rs 250 short). At 1 AM Ammi gave him a potli: her savings Rs 400 + 6 parathay ('roz phone karna'); Abbu said nothing, just put a hand on his head. 18-hour bus (-Rs 1,500). Karachi bus adda 2 AM: chai Rs 30 -> Rs 120 left; a guard (blue cap, moustache) woke him off the bench ('Yahan sona mana hai!'); slept on the floor hugging his bag while a shady man eyed it; ate Ammi's cold parathay. Cliffhanger: wakes at 8:40 AM - interview at 9 AM, address 25 km away, rickshaw Rs 400, jeb Rs 120. Day 7 (Kiraye Ki Bike): rickshaw wanted Rs 400 (kam nahi hoga); rented a 70cc bike from Chacha Ghafoor (GHAFOOR BIKE CENTER, Rs 100/din, 'brake ki koi guarantee nahi') -> Rs 20. Traffic jam at 8:50, gali shortcut blocked by a bhains ('Sorry bhains ji'), downhill the brakes failed - crashed into cardboard boxes at the TEZ DELIVERY head office gate exactly at 9:00. The manager (blue shirt, red tie, clipboard) laughed: 'bike toh chala lete ho, test do' - first order in 30 min without brakes (chappal as brake). Ammi's voice note mid-ride ('pohanch gaye beta? nashta kiya?'). Lift kharab, 5 floors on foot; delivered with 01:12 left: first 5-star rating + Rs 50 tip -> Rs 70. NAUKRI PAKKI. Cliffhanger: back at Ghafoor's at night, he finds the dent - 'Yeh dent kis ne daala? Paanch sau nikaalo!' Jurmana Rs 500 vs jeb Rs 70. Day 8 (Barish): Ghafoor deal - dent fine paid as Rs 50/day qist + Rs 100 daily kiraya. Big order: 3 kg birthday cake, 25 min. Karachi monsoon: thunder, road became a river, engine died, his chappal floated away (funny), pushed the bike 2 km; Ammi's voice note 'bahar mat nikalna!'. Opened the box under an awning - cake melted (Rs 1,200, 'paise katenge?'). At FLAT 2-A, Master Saleem (retired teacher, white curly hair, gold glasses, maroon vest; 'Best Teacher 1998') said 'cake chhoro, tum bheeg gaye ho', gave chai + towel, asked 'parhte kyun nahi?' - '82% thay sir, fees nahi thi.' Said 'mithaas wohi hai', gave 5 stars + Rs 200 tip and a chit. Paid Ghafoor Rs 150 -> Rs 120; jurmana baaki Rs 450. Cliffhanger: chit says 'Kal subah 8 baje aana, ek imtihaan hai - M. Saleem', and the manager texts 'Kal 8 baje duty. Late = naukri khatam.' Dono 8 baje! Day 9 (Imtihaan Ya Naukri): Ghafoor's bike wouldn't start - tanki khaali, petrol Rs 100 -> Rs 20. At a fork (IMTIHAAN vs NAUKRI) he chose duty ('naukri gayi toh Abbu ki dawai bhi gayi'). Manager: 'aaj 10 order, ek bhi late = bahar'; Hamid's stomach growled in the briefing ('Sir… yeh mera pet tha'). Order 3/10 was FLAT 2-A - Master Saleem's home: a 5-question, 5-minute doorstep test while the order timer ran; his pen's ink ran out, Saleem lent his gold pen; 5/5 - 'tum scholarship ke laayak ho'. Finished 10/10 orders on an empty stomach (dizzy). Evening: spent his last Rs 20 on biscuits and shared half with a hungry street kid (new character Z, orange T-shirt). Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: Master Saleem texts - scholarship test parson, form fee Rs 1,000, aakhri din KAL. Jeb Rs 0. (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450 + daily kiraya/qist.) Day 10 (Ammi Ki Call): Needed Rs 1,000 for the form by midnight with Rs 0. The manager laughed off an advance ('pehle mahina poora karo'); Bilal video-called with 'Scheme 2.0: paise triple' - Hamid cut the call. Day tips Rs 440. 6 PM Ammi called: Abbu's dawai finished, Rs 1,000 - now Rs 2,000 needed. Night shift at SETH RAUF HOTEL (new character Seth Rauf, R: slicked hair, big moustache, green waistcoat; Rs 500/night, 'cup toota toh paise katenge'); a cup flew off the tray and landed on Hamid's head without spilling ('Lahore ki training') - Rauf added Rs 100 inaam -> Rs 1,040. At 11:58 PM he sent Rs 1,000 to Ammi for the dawai; form deadline passed (FORM: BAND). Rs 40. Ammi: 'dawai le aaye, Abbu ne kha li, jeete raho'. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger 12:07 AM: Master Saleem texts 'Form maine bhar diya. Kal subah 9 baje test. Par ek shart hai…' (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450 + daily kiraya/qist; Rauf's night shift may continue.) Day 11 (Ek Shart): Saleem's shart - score below 90% and Hamid owes him the Rs 1,000 form fee. After the all-night shift at Rauf's he dozed off at 6 AM and woke at 8:15 to Rauf shouting; Ghafoor refused the bike until the Rs 450 jurmana is paid; took a packed city bus hanging at the door (Rs 30 -> Rs 10), Ammi's voice note 'imtihaan achha dena', traffic jam at 8:40, ran the last 2 km. At the test center gate the guard wanted a printed admit card (print Rs 20, jeb Rs 10); the street kid Z ran up with Rs 10 ('biscuit ka badla') - inside at 8:59. Mid-paper the bijli went (fan stopped, dark hall); he finished 50/50 by window light. Saleem: 'kaisa gaya?' - 'poori jaan laga di'. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 6 PM: result board - HAMID 89% (scholarship needs 90%): ek number kam... ab Rs 1,000 ka karza? (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450.) Day 12 (Ek Number Kam): Saleem texted 'shart yaad hai? Rs 1,000 itwaar tak'; the manager texted 'bike ke bina duty nahi, kal tak bike lao warna naukri khatam' - needed Rs 1,450 with Rs 0. Day shift at Seth Rauf Hotel (Rs 500, 'kuch toota toh paise katenge'), lunch rush, tray nearly fell. A customer (blue shirt) left without paying the Rs 300 bill - Rauf: 'teri mez thi, tere katenge'; Hamid chased him through the bazaar (jumped a bakri, lost a chappal) and caught him at the bus stop ('jaldi mein bhool gaya') - Rs 300 + Rs 50 tip. Rauf paid Rs 500 + tip -> Rs 550, 'kal bhi aana'. Offered Rs 550 to Master Saleem; he said 'paise rakho, qarza aise utaaro - mohalle ke bachon ko parhao': 10 din tuition = karza khatam (class starts tomorrow). Paid Ghafoor the Rs 450 jurmana -> bike back (kiraya Rs 100 roz), naukri bach gayi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 100. Cliffhanger 11:45 PM: Ammi's voice note 'beta, result kya aaya?' (he typed 'Ammi, 89%...' and deleted it); then SCHOLARSHIP OFFICE: 'aapki copy recheck hui... sawaal 37 mein ghalti... naya result: ??%' - natija badal gaya, par kis taraf? (Owes nothing now except daily bike kiraya; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids for 10 days.) Day 13 (Asli Certificate): the recheck came back 90% - scholarship manzoor! But Master Saleem (at the scholarship office) said the ASAL 12th certificate must be submitted by KAL 5 BAJE - and it is in Lahore with Ammi. At his first evening tuition (10 noisy mohalla kids; a paper plane hit his head) Ammi called: courier takes 3 days. Bilal's 'Scheme 3.0': his cousin is the conductor on the night Lahore-Karachi bus; Ammi gave the envelope to Bilal; Rs 100 chai-paani. Next day the bus came an hour late (4 PM); Hamid got the lifafa, paid Rs 100 (Rs 0), rode full speed and reached the office at 4:59 PM. Cliffhanger: he opened the lifafa - no certificate inside, only one of Bilal's old DUMMY PHONES (from Day 3). Where is the certificate? Deadline 5 PM. (Still: daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids, 10 days.) Day 14 (Dummy Phone): at 4:59 PM, with a dummy phone instead of the certificate, Bilal video-called: the lifafay got swapped - the certificate is with him, and he is in KARACHI (surprise!) at the bus adda. Master Saleem stalled the afsar with chai ('jao, bhaago!'). Hamid raced 5 km - red signal, then the bike's petrol ran out; ran the rest and found Bilal eating samosay; the certificate came back with oil stains ('bas thoda sa tel'). Rickshaw back - kiraya Bilal ne diya. 5:20 PM, the afsar's third chai: certificate jama, scholarship pakki. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: Bilal says he will now stay in Karachi with Hamid; the scholarship letter says classes start KAL subah 8 baje - and his delivery duty is also at 8. (Bike out of petrol at the signal; still daily kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids.) Day 15 (Class Ya Duty): class and delivery duty both at 8 AM. Bilal's plan: he does Hamid's duty wearing the red TEZ helmet ('koi nahi pehchanega'). First BBA class (new character P, the professor: glasses, navy blazer, grey beard) - Bilal called ('customer ka ghar nahi mil raha'), Hamid whispered the location and the professor confiscated his phone. At break: 9 missed calls + manager text 'rider ne customer ke samosay kha liye - office aao abhi'. At the office Bilal (visor up): 'samosay garam thay, check kar raha tha'. Hamid took the blame and proposed subah class, shaam double duty - manager agreed: duty 2 PM-10 PM, samosay Rs 150 tankhwah se kategi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 10:15 PM: Ammi calls - 'Beta… Abbu hospital mein hain…' - and his jeb has Rs 0. (Bilal now in Karachi; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's kids clashes with the new 2-10 PM shift.) Day 16 (Paanch Hazaar): 10:15 PM - Ammi (crying): the doctor needs Rs 5,000 by morning for Abbu's treatment/injection; Hamid has Rs 0 and promised 'main bhejunga'. Koshish #1: asked the manager for an advance by message - 'samosay walay ko? Bilkul nahi!' (REJECTED). Koshish #2: Bilal offered to sell 'his phone' - it was the Day 3 dummy phone. Koshish #3, 12 AM at Seth Rauf Hotel: Rauf shouted 'paagal ho?', Hamid offered to work free every night for Abbu's ilaaj; after a silence Rauf handed over a Rs 5,000 advance ('rona band karo'). 1 AM: sent Rs 5,000 to Ammi - injection lag gaya, Abbu theek hain. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 1:30 AM: Rauf's shart - a sealed brown packet (string + red seal) to deliver KAL RAAT 2 BAJE: 'kholna mat, kisi ko batana mat'. What's in the packet? (Now owes Rauf: free night work against the Rs 5,000 advance; manager's Rs 150 samosa cut; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Bilal in Karachi.) Day 17 (Raat 2 Baje): Bilal wanted to open Rauf's sealed packet ('shayad note hon!'); Hamid refused, Bilal sniffed it and sneezed (AAACHHOO, packet flew). 1:30 AM ride to a purani haveli 10 km away: tyre puncture, three dogs chased him, he pushed the bike and arrived at exactly 2:00. The haveli door creaked open by itself; an old woman (Amma ji, new character N: white chaddar, silver glasses, lavender kameez, no voice) with a lantern. Inside the packet: dawaiyan + a chit 'Ammi, maaf karna… aapka Rauf' - she is Seth Rauf's estranged mother; 'sakht Seth, andar se naram'. Amma ji gave dua + Rs 500. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 500. Cliffhanger 2:45 AM: police naka - 'Kaghaz dikhao!' - but the bike is Ghafoor's and the papers are with Ghafoor. (Still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Bilal in Karachi.) Day 18 (Kaghaz Dikhao): 2:45 AM police naka - the havaldar said the bike goes to the thana (bike gayi = naukri gayi). Called Ghafoor - phone band, chacha snoring. Aakhri umeed: Seth Rauf at 3 AM ('pagal ho?') - Hamid: 'aapki Ammi ke ghar se aa raha hoon'; silence; 'das minute, wahin ruko'. Rauf came in pajama, a striped night cap and one chappal: 'yeh mera banda hai, chai meri taraf se!' - the havaldar laughed and let him go. Rauf softly asked 'Ammi kaisi thin?' - 'aapko bohat yaad kar rahi thin' - the sakht Seth cried. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger, subah: Amma ji's Rs 500 is gone from under his pillow - Bilal's chit: 'PAISE DOUBLE KARKE LAATA HOON!' (Bilal Scheme 4.0). Rs 0. (Still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.) Day 19 (Jadugar Ka Dabba): Bilal's phone was off, but his status said 'PAISE DOUBLE HO RAHE HAIN - SEA VIEW'. At the beach Bilal had put Hamid's Rs 500 into a street jadugar's 'DOUBLE BOX' (new character J: purple top hat, sunglasses, black star waistcoat, thin curled moustache; no voice) - '500 daalo, 1000 nikalo, ek ghante mein double'. Hamid: 'pehle dabba kholo!' - the jadugar ran with the box; Ghafoor's bike got stuck in the sand; Bilal ran and fell face-first in the sand. A beach camel walked in front - the jadugar crashed into it, the box broke: only raddi kaghaz inside + their one real Rs 500 note. Bilal: 'sorry yaar, scheme 4.0 fail'. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 500. Cliffhanger, shaam 5 baje: Ammi calls - the doctor has sent Abbu to Karachi for ilaaj, 'kal subah hum aa rahe hain!' - ilaaj Karachi mein, jeb mein sirf Rs 500. (Still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.) Day 20 (Hospital Ki Line): 7 AM at the Karachi bus adda Abbu stepped off the Lahore bus and collapsed; Ammi: 'jaldi hospital chalo!'. Rickshaw Rs 400 (kam nahi hoga) -> Rs 100. CITY HOSPITAL OPD: a line of 100+ people and the parchi window says Rs 300 - Rs 200 short. Bilal ran in with no money, only a marigold phoolon ka haar ('Abbu ka welcome toh banta hai!'). Then Abbu quietly took a folded Rs 200 from his pocket: 'Rakh lo… beta.' Parchi ban gayi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: Ammi in tears outside the doctor's room - 'doctor kehta hai operation hoga… pachaas hazaar, ek hafte mein!' Rs 50,000 in one week, jeb Rs 0. (Ammi + Abbu now in Karachi - where they stay is open; still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.) Day 21 (Ek Hi Din): Hisaab - Rs 50,000 / 7 din = Rs 7,000 roz. Bilal's Scheme 5.0: a LUCKY LOTTERY ticket ('1 crore!'); Hamid tore it ('woh jeetne wali thi!'). Raat 10 baje the hospital guard (X) whistled everyone out - 'raat ko rukna mana hai'; hotel room Rs 2,000, Ammi said she'd sleep on the footpath. Seth Rauf arrived (Bilal had told him): 'footpath pe? mere hote hue?' - gave his hotel's upstairs room to Ammi ('aaj se Ammi ka') and put an 'ABBU KA OPERATION' dabba on the counter; customers dropped Rs 3,000 overnight. Ammi ko chhat mili. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 3,000. Cliffhanger: CITY HOSPITAL message - 'Operation PARSON! Paise KAL SHAAM tak' - saat din nahi, sirf ek din; Rs 47,000 baaki. (Ammi stays in Rauf's upstairs room; Abbu admitted at City Hospital; still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.) Day 22 (Kaali Gaari): Rs 47,000 in one day. 7 AM double duty - first order, tyre puncture (PHUSSS); Bilal's Scheme 6.0: a hand air pump ('main hawa bharunga!') - his first scheme that worked (SCHEMES: 5 FAIL, 1 PASS). By 6 PM 20 orders = +Rs 2,000 (Rs 5,000); Chacha Ghafoor demanded 10 days' bike kiraya Rs 1,000 -> Rs 4,000 (Rs 46,000 short). Raat 9 baje at Rauf's hotel Master Saleem came with two mohalla kids: 'poore mohalle ne chanda kiya hai, beta' - the kids had broken their gullaks; Rs 15,000. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 19,000; Rs 31,000 baaki, deadline kal shaam. Cliffhanger: a shiny black car (tinted windows) stopped; the rear window came down and a parchi fell out: 'BAAKI PAISE MERE. BAS EK KAAM KARNA HOGA…' - who is it, and what kaam? (Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; Abbu at City Hospital, operation parson; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.) Day 23 (Gaari Mein Kaun?): Bilal: 'mat ja, yeh koi don hai!' - the black car's door opened: AMMA JI (Seth Rauf's mother). Her kaam: 'Rauf ko mere paas lao.' Raat 10 baje at the hotel Rauf flared up - 'bees saal baad yaad aaya? Nahi jaunga!' - DHADAM, door slammed. Outside, the car started to leave; Bilal's Scheme 7.0: he lay down in front of it (CHEEEN - it stopped; SCHEMES: 5 FAIL, 2 PASS). Hamid shouted 'Seth! Ammi ja rahi hain!' - Rauf ran out barefoot; 'Ammi… mujhe maaf kar do' - maa-beta milap after 20 years. Amma ji gave Hamid a lifafa: Rs 31,000 -> Rs 50,000 poore. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger, subah: paise jama (Rs 0), then the doctor: 'khoon chahiye! O-NEGATIVE… do ghante mein!' (Rauf-Amma ji reconciled; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; Abbu at City Hospital, operation paid; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor.) Day 24 (O-Negative): Abbu's operation needs O-negative blood in 2 hours. The blood bank: 'O-negative stock khatam!'. Hamid tested B-positive; Bilal ('mera lo!') A-positive - match nahi. Ammi (crying): 'sirf ek ghanta bacha hai!'. Bilal's Scheme 8.0: a loudspeaker on a rickshaw through the whole bazaar - 'O-negative chahiye! Koi hai?' - sannata. Then a hand rose in the crowd: the JADUGAR from Day 19 (dabbe wala), with a donor card O-NEG; 'is baar jadugar ne asli cheez di' (SCHEMES: 5 FAIL, 3 PASS). Operation kamyab. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: the manager texts '3 din se ghayab? NAUKRI KHATAM. Bike wapas karo.' (Abbu recovering after the operation at City Hospital; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; Rauf-Amma ji reconciled; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings; delivery job now lost; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor.) Day 25 (Pachaas Biryani): at TEZ DELIVERY Hamid said 'Sir, Abbu ka operation tha!' - the manager didn't listen ('rule is rule, bahar!', DHADAM). Chacha Ghafoor: 'naukri gayi? toh bike wapas karo!' - took the chaabi, ab paidal. Then the manager ran out: urgent shaadi order, 50 biryani to the SHAADI HALL by 8 baje, koi rider nahi; Hamid: 'main le jaunga!' (bike kahan hai?). Bilal's Scheme 9.0: his cousin's rickshaw ('rickshaw haazir hai!'); 50 dabbe thoons diye. Speed breaker - DHAMAK, one box flew, Bilal caught it ('boti bach gayi!') (SCHEMES: 5 FAIL, 4 PASS). Shaadi hall theek 8 baje: manager texted 'NAUKRI WAPAS. LAST WARNING!' + Rs 500 inaam. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 500. Cliffhanger, raat 11 baje: the PROFESSOR texts '3 class miss. Kal 8 baje QUIZ. Fail = scholarship khatam.' - and Bilal admits he sold Hamid's kitaabein to the raddi wala (holding Rs 200). (Delivery job back on last warning but the bike is still with Ghafoor - chaabi taken; Abbu recovering at City Hospital; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 26 (Pakode Wali Kitaab): raat 11 baje the raddi shop was band; Bilal banged the shutter, the raddi wala opened his upstairs window: 'bik gayin! pakode wale ko!'. The pakode wala (new: orange rumal, green banyan, apron) had already made pakora lifafe from the pages; Bilal: 'pakode bhi khao, padhai bhi karo!'. Hamid bought all the lifafe for Rs 100 and taped the oily pages together all night - but chapter 5 was missing; Bilal had 'read it while eating pakode' and taught it: 'pakode kam, bhook zyada... daam double!' (demand-supply). Subah 8 baje quiz: Q1 from chapter 5 - Hamid remembered Bilal's line: 9/10, scholarship bach gayi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 400. Cliffhanger: outside college the manager texts 'aaj 2 baje duty, late = naukri khatam' - and the bike is still with Ghafoor. (Delivery job on last warning; bike chaabi with Ghafoor; Abbu recovering at City Hospital; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 27 (Petrol Chor): 1 PM, duty at 2, bike locked at Ghafoor's. Ghafoor: 'pehle kiraya do! poore hazaar!' - Hamid had Rs 400; Bilal's Scheme 10.0: 'baaki ke badle main girwi!' - Ghafoor laughed, 'chal bartan dho!' (Bilal now washing dishes at Ghafoor's as girwi for the Rs 600) and gave the chaabi. Rs 0. 1:30 PM the petrol ran out in the middle of the road; pump 2 km, jeb khaali; pushed the bike to NOOR GENERAL STORE where SADIA (new character S: pink dupatta, sky-blue kurta, braid; cheerful) offered paani - 'paani nahi, petrol!' - and gave one litre of her shop's generator petrol on UDHAAR; he asked her name. Office at 1:59 - time pe. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: his first order is from Noor General Store - note: 'PETROL CHOR KO BHEJO!' (owes Sadia 1 litre petrol; owes Ghafoor Rs 600 - Bilal is 'girwi'; delivery job on last warning, duty 2-10 PM; Abbu recovering at City Hospital; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 28 (Tees Ande): 2 PM at Noor General Store Sadia teased him - 'aa gaye petrol chor? pehle mera litre!'; jeb Rs 0, he promised 'tankhwah pe'. The order: 30 ande for Master Saleem - 'ek bhi toota toh paise tumhare!'. On the way a gaddha (DHAMAK, eggs jumped), then street kids' cricket ball flew at him - he caught something one-handed and put it in his pocket. At FLAT 2-A Master Saleem counted: 29 ande + 1 cricket ball! Hamid had caught the EGG - it came out of his pocket salamat (30/30). Saleem laughed: 'aisa catch!' and tipped Rs 100. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 100. Cliffhanger: Bilal's voice note - he broke 10 plates washing dishes at Ghafoor's; chacha now wants Rs 2,000. (Owes Sadia 1 litre petrol, promised 'tankhwah pe'; owes Ghafoor Rs 2,000 - Bilal still 'girwi'; delivery job on last warning, duty 2-10 PM; Abbu recovering at City Hospital; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 29 (Steel Ki Plate): raat 10 baje at Ghafoor's, chacha demanded Rs 2,000 for the 10 plates Bilal broke ('saabun tha, plate phisal gayi'); Hamid's Rs 100 was laughed off ('Bilal saal bhar bartan dhoyega!'). Bilal's Scheme 11.0: glue (GOND) - the plate didn't join, his fingers stuck to it (FAIL). Aakhri umeed, Noor General Store at 10:20 PM: Sadia teased 'phir udhaar? pehle petrol, ab kya?' and gave 10 STEEL plates (Rs 500: Rs 100 abhi, baaki udhaar). Ghafoor dropped one - TANNN - tooti nahi! 'Hisaab barabar, kiraya tankhwah pe' - Bilal azaad. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger, raat 11 baje: Ammi's voice note - 'kal Abbu ki chhutti… kehte hain, Hamid Lahore wapas chale!' (Owes Sadia Rs 400 + 1 litre petrol; owes Ghafoor Rs 600 kiraya 'tankhwah pe' - Bilal free; Abbu discharged tomorrow and wants Hamid back in Lahore; delivery job on last warning, duty 2-10 PM; Ammi in Rauf's upstairs room; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 30 (Lahore Wapas?): subah 9 baje, City Hospital - Abbu discharged, holding THREE bus tickets (Abbu, Ammi, Hamid) for raat 10 baje: 'Sadkon pe dhakke! Ye naukri hai?' Then the office message: 2 baje late = chhutti - Abbu: 'Dekha! Saamaan baandho!'; Ammi: 'Abbu ki baat maan lo.' Seth Rauf walked in with fruit: 'Kaun Lahore ja raha hai? Raat ko bartan, din mein delivery, subah college!' + 'aur mere paanch hazaar kaun dega?' Abbu, quiet: 'Ek mahina… kuch ban ke dikhao' and TORE Hamid's ticket. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger, raat 10 baje at the Karachi bus adda: from the bus window Abbu set the condition - 'Ek mahine mein tees hazaar… warna Lahore!' (Goal: save Rs 30,000 in one month or go back to Lahore; Abbu + Ammi back in Lahore; owes Sadia Rs 400 + 1 litre petrol; owes Ghafoor Rs 600 kiraya 'tankhwah pe'; delivery job on last warning, duty 2-10 PM; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings.) Day 31 (Exam Special Chai): subah 6 baje - Rs 30,000 in 30 din = Rs 1,000 roz, warna Lahore. Plan: chai at his own college gate (City College) before the 8 AM class. Seth Rauf lent a ketli - 'doodh tumhara!' (Rs 400 doodh on udhaar). Guard's seeti: 'yahan thela mana hai!'; across the road nobody stopped; 7:45 - chai thandi, Hamid bhi. Bilal's Scheme 12: 'Exam special chai! Ek cup, poora syllabus yaad!' - a line formed; even the guard took 2 cups: 'kisi ko mat batana!'. 40 cups (Rs 1,200) minus Rs 400 doodh = Rs 800. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger, after class: office message - 'Kal se duty subah 8 baje! Late = chhutti' (clashes with college at 8 and the 7 AM chai). (Goal: Rs 30,000 by the month's end - Rs 800 so far; owes Sadia Rs 400 + 1 litre petrol; owes Ghafoor Rs 600 kiraya 'tankhwah pe'; owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; Abbu + Ammi in Lahore.)
